text.zh: +20 到 400 基础生命值（随等级提升），+2 到 25 护甲和魔法抗性（随等级提升）

note.en: The wiki notes ranged champions currently get no bonus armor or magic resist (a bug).
note.zh: 英雄联盟维基注：远程英雄的护甲和魔法抗性加成目前存在程序错误，实际没有生效。

text.zh: 所有英雄自带【气定神闲】

text.en: Each 1% crit chance over 100% gives 0.45 attack damage or 0.75 ability power (adaptive)
text.zh: 暴击几率超过 100% 的部分，每 1% 转化为 0.45 攻击力或 0.75 法术强度（自适应）

text.en: Each new immobilize gives tenacity for 3.25 seconds. Immobilized for 5 of the last 7 seconds: cleansed and immune to crowd control for 3 seconds.
text.zh: 每次受到新的定身效果时获得韧性，持续 3.25 秒；最近 7 秒内被定身满 5 秒时，立即净化所有控制效果并免疫控制效果 3 秒。

text.en: Heals 22% of missing health and restores 22% of missing mana in an area
text.zh: 范围治疗 22% 已损失生命值，并回复 22% 已损失法力值

text.en: Give nearby allied minions 20% attack speed and 20% movement speed
text.zh: 为附近的友方小兵提供 20% 攻击速度和 20% 移动速度

text.en: Only 1 per wave while the enemy inhibitor is down
text.zh: 敌方召唤水晶被摧毁时，每波只出 1 个超级兵

text.en: The inhibitor turret takes 40% less damage for 70 seconds
text.zh: 水晶防御塔在 70 秒内受到的伤害降低 40%

text.en: Outer, inhibitor and Nexus turrets: 120 to 144 armor and magic resist (by minute). Outer turrets no longer drop to 40 after 12 minutes.
text.zh: 外防御塔、水晶防御塔、枢纽防御塔：120 到 144 护甲和魔法抗性（随时间提升）；外防御塔不再在 12 分钟后降至 40。

text.en: Outer and inhibitor turrets have 3 plates worth 100 gold each (split). Each plate lost gives a Bulwark stack for 20 seconds: 60 to 80 armor and magic resist (more with more enemy champions within 850 range), up to 120 to 160 at 2 stacks.
text.zh: 外防御塔和水晶防御塔各有 3 层镀层，每层 100 金币（由参与者平分）。每失去一层，防御塔获得一层【坚强壁垒】，持续 20 秒：60 到 80 护甲和魔法抗性（防御塔 850 码内存活的敌方英雄越多越高），2 层时最多 120 到 160。
枢纽防御塔 3000 生命值（原 1800）；枢纽 3000 生命值（原 5500）

text.en: At the start (level 3), then levels 7, 11 and 15; only while you can shop (dead, or at your spawn)
text.zh: 开局（3 级）一次，之后 7、11、15 级各一次；只在可以购买装备时出现（阵亡或在泉水）

text.en: Silver, Gold or Prismatic, the same for every player each time and random; the first two can't both be Silver
text.zh: 白银阶、黄金阶或棱彩阶，每次全场相同且随机；前两次不会都是白银阶

text.en: Each offer can be rerolled once, for up to 6 choices; an augment never shows up twice in a game
text.zh: 每个选项可以刷新一次，最多 6 选 1；同一个强化符文在一局中不会出现两次

effect.en: Empower one of your basic Abilities, granting it 20 Ability Haste, 10% increased damage, and 10% increased Healing and Shielding.At Level 18, Empower another Ability-- even your Ultimate!
effect.zh: 强化你的一个基础技能，为它提供20技能急速、10%额外伤害、以及10%治疗和护盾效果。在18级时，强化另一个技能——甚至可以是你的终极技能！

effect.en: K/DA will occasionally throw Photocards to their loyal fans! Collect them all to gain an additional Augment and prove your devotion!
effect.zh: K/DA会时不时地投掷明星卡给她们的忠实粉丝们！集齐它们就会获得一个额外的强化符文并证明你的忠诚！

effect.en: Multi-kills, shutdowns, and destroying towers excite Minions, causing them to drop Anvils for the team that generated the hype!
effect.zh: 多杀、终结连杀、以及摧毁防御塔都会激起小兵的干劲，使它们为提供干劲的队伍掉落锻造器！

effect.en: HEARTSTEEL members have a chance to put Stickers on your Augments, granting you a bonus if you pick the Augment with a Sticker. Each member provides a unique bonus.
effect.zh: 【心之钢】成员们有一定几率给你的强化符文贴上贴纸，从而在你选择一个带贴纸的强化符文时为你提供一个加成。每个成员会提供一个独特加成。

effect.en: The Health Relic Aura restoresan additional 20% missing Health and grants 25% bonus Move Speed that decays over 6 seconds.
effect.zh: 治疗圣物光环会额外回复20%已损失生命值，并提供在6秒里持续衰减的25%移动速度加成。

effect.en: Boogie down on the Dance Floor until the Disco Ball drops, granting everyone 1000 gold!
effect.zh: 跳起舞步跃入舞池直到迪斯科灯球落下，从而为每个人提供1000金币！

effect.en: Honey and Bees periodically fly across the map. Collecting Small Honey grants you and your team 25 gold and heals you for 15% of your maximum health. Big Honey grants 100 gold and heals you for 30% of your maximum health. Being struck by a Small Bee damages you for 10% of your maximum health. Big Bees damage you for 20% of your maximum health
effect.zh: 蜂蜜和蜜蜂会周期性地飞越地图。收集小块蜂蜜可为你和你的队伍提供25金币，并为你治疗15%最大生命值。收集大块蜂蜜可提供100金币，并为你治疗30%最大生命值。被小蜜蜂蜇到会对你造成10%最大生命值的伤害。大蜜蜂会对你造成20%最大生命值的伤害。

effect.en: Your first reroll each Augment Selection also increases the rarity of the rerolled Augment.
effect.zh: 你在每轮符文选择中的第一次刷新还会提升被刷新强化符文的稀有度。

effect.en: All players have their level cap increased to 21 and gain additiona experience. Gain an extra Augment at level 21!
effect.zh: 所有玩家的等级上限提升至21并获得额外经验值。在21级时获得一个额外的强化符文！

effect.en: Takedowns give Tokens; spend 4 while dead to revive at your spawn.
effect.zh: 参与击杀获得代币；阵亡时用 4 枚代币在泉水复活。

effect.en: Each augment offer also gives 200, 350, 500 or 700 gold (random) and hats.
effect.zh: 每次强化符文选择额外提供 200、350、500 或 700 金币（随机）以及帽子。

effect.en: Allies drop a candle where they die (10 seconds); picking it up shields you and allies within 1500 range for 4 seconds.
effect.zh: 友方英雄阵亡处掉落一根蜡烛（持续 10 秒）；友方拾取后为自己和 1500 码内的友方英雄提供护盾，持续 4 秒。

effect.en: Augment offers show 4 choices instead of 3.
effect.zh: 强化符文选择从 3 个选项变为 4 个。
